title: dam doctor answer
description: What dam doctor prints on standard output with --json or --toon. It exits 1 when a check that ran is an issue, and prints no error document.

command.description: The command that produced the report.

checks.description: Each check that ran, in the order the report shows them.

needs_attention.description: Each issue, then each warning, as the closing section numbers them.

name.description: The check, by the name dam doctor takes.

result.description: What the check found; not_run when it could not run.

detail.description: What the check found, in words.

advice.description: What to do next, or null.

config.description: On the config check: the path of config.lua, or null when there is none.

secrets.description: On the config check: the path of secrets.lua, beside config.lua, or null when there is none.

warnings.description: On the config check: each token dam ignores or holds disabled, and why.
